How to play

Press Space or click the lake to cast the swinging hook. It reels back automatically.

  • Boosts start when the orb reaches the dock. All three types are equally likely and rarer than fish.
  • Each green orb doubles the points for one fish. Extra orbs add extra uses.
  • Yellow: 2× reeling for 10 seconds. Blue: freeze fish and orbs for 5 seconds. Catch the same type again to refresh its timer.
  • Small fish reel in fastest; big fish are slowest. Boots slow the hook and give no points.
  • Earn stars at 5, 15, and 30 points. Reach 30 to win. Each new star gives 10 coins, once.

P or Escape pauses the game and boost timers. Switching tabs pauses automatically.
